mustFix.problem: Horizontal overflow at 390 (629px) and 320 (623px): open-now pill plus full-label call button do not fit the header
mustFix.fix: Under 640px hide .open-now-pill in the header, collapse .btn-call to a 48x48 icon button with aria-label 'Call {{biz.phone}}', set .header__actions{min-width:0;flex-shrink:1}; re-run check-render with zero overflow

mustFix.problem: All 8 photos are media/placeholder-*.jpg grey boxes with alt 'Placeholder for ...'
mustFix.fix: Place approved niche-library frames via [[img]] for every slot (hero-B1, crew, break, story-1, story-2, season-heat, plants-native, tools-hand) with descriptive alt and real credit hrefs

mustFix.problem: Reveal targets stay invisible while in the viewport with motion on
mustFix.fix: Make the reveal fire (start 'top 85%', once:true, ScrollTrigger.refresh after fonts and images load); keep the base state visible and apply the hidden state only under a class added when the trigger registers
